name: Wreck
author: L'Cronx
summary: A self-sampling sound design instrument: ten sources (noise, clicks, your own WAV files, FM, attractors and more) run through five blocks in any order into a 20 second loop that MIDI voices play back, and the voices can feed the chain again. 4-lane polymetric arp, bouncing-ball delay, 22 presets. MPC OS 3.x.
